title: Verifiable Random Sampling of Private Data Without a Trusted Single Party
abstract: arXiv:2611.21222v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Problem: When a party supports claims about a private dataset by disclosing a sample, auditors cannot tell whether it was drawn at random or "cherry-picked" to hide flaws in the rest of the data.   Solution: The data holder commits to the hashes of every item in its dataset and registers the commitment with independent servers. Selection then waits on a decentralized randomness beacon: a network that jointly emits a fresh random value every few seconds, outside the control of the data holder and the auditors. The value emitted two beacon rounds after the commitment picks the sample. Each server returns a signed receipt, so anyone can later check that the revealed sample is exactly the one that value prescribes. Selection from the committed set stays unbiased as long as the beacon's threshold holds and one required server is honest, and a pre-agreed name, checked with the servers, stops repeated or abandoned draws. We call this protocol

translated_title: 无需可信单一方的私有数据可验证随机抽样
translated_abstract: 问题：当一方通过披露一个样本来支持其关于私有数据集的声明时，审计者无法判断该样本是随机抽取的，还是经过“精心挑选”以掩盖其余数据中的缺陷。解决方案：数据持有者对其数据集中每一项的哈希值作出承诺，并将该承诺注册到独立的服务器上。抽样过程随后等待去中心化随机信标——一个每隔几秒共同发布一个全新随机值的网络，该网络不受数据持有者和审计者的控制。承诺发布两轮信标之后产生的随机值用于选取样本。每台服务器都会返回签名回执，因此任何人事后都可以核验所披露的样本正是该随机值所规定的那一个。只要信标的阈值成立且一台必需的服务器是诚实的，从已承诺集合中的抽样就保持无偏；同时，经服务器核验的事先约定的名称可以防止重复抽样或中途放弃的抽样。我们将此协议称为（原文在此处截断，协议名称缺失）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需可信第三方的可验证随机抽样协议，通过哈希承诺、去中心化随机信标和服务器签名回执，保证从私有数据集中抽取的样本真正随机、无法被“精心挑选”，从而使审计者能够信任样本对整个数据集的代表性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a protocol for verifiable random sampling of private data without a trusted single party, combining hash commitments, a decentralized randomness beacon, and signed server receipts to guarantee that samples are truly random and cannot be cherry-picked, enabling auditors to trust the sample's representativeness of the whole dataset.
